title: HIGH: eraser cutting an angled stroke across a brush LINE deletes one whole side (planar arrangement topology / data loss)
description: FIXED (HIGH data-loss). ROOT CAUSE: planar arrangement KERNEL (engine/planar/arrangement.ts insertEdge). When two edges cross, insertEdge split BOTH at the crossing but discarded the intersector's snapped point and re-evaluated each edge's OWN geometry at its OWN parameter (edgeAt(geom,t)) then re-snapped. The two re-evaluations of the SAME crossing — along edge A's param vs edge B's param — landed in ADJACENT twip cells (angled eraser-capsule edge x band top edge: (102.65,95) on capsule side vs (102.70,95) on band side, 1 twip apart). The should-be-shared vertices did NOT merge -> half-edge rotation ring at the crossing malformed -> the far (right) region failed to close into a bounded face, leaked into the UNBOUNDED face, and vanished on read-back (one whole side deleted). FIX: thread the authoritative snapped intersection point through the split (Split={t,point}) and PIN each interior split vertex to that exact point in chopEdge/splitLocal (controls still de Casteljau; only the shared endpoint forced). Same crossing now yields identical vertex coord on every edge -> exact-key merge -> angled cut splits into TWO bounded faces. VERIFY: angled (90,90)->(110,112) sz6 now fills=2 x=[0,200] area~1837 (was fills=1 x=[0,96] area=910); kernel isolation now yields 2 bounded filled faces (right face x=[102.7,200]). core engine tests 1201/1201 pass; full core 5480 pass (only 3 pre-existing flash8-empty.fla fixture-missing failures, task-1207 acceptable); SWF 1466/1466 pass. 8 merge-drawing-oracle e2e all diff=0/220000. REGRESSION: planar-eraser.test.ts 'angled cut splits a band into two surviving sides (task 1332)' (4 cases: angled both-sides-full-span, area-conserved, fatter cut, perpendicular control) — FAILS pre-fix (area 909.5, 1 face), PASSES post-fix.
